description:
JSR 269 annotation processor for dev.pathland.view. Ships two processors:
        (1) generates a <View>_StateBinder per view class that wires each
        State field to the session's PersistentState (auto-keyed by field name,
        recursing into nested view fields); (2) ViewAuthoringProcessor enforces
        the configurator convention — errors on public/protected parameterized
        constructors in custom View and Style implementations (spec DSL.md §2).
        Framework-agnostic — used by Quarkus, Spring Boot, and desktop.
